column1: # RDR-229 P3.5a (nexus-p2m1x.23): every statement in service/src/main that takes a row lock (FOR UPDATE, FOR SHARE, FOR NO KEY UPDATE, FOR KEY SHARE),
# and its order relative to the registry read of its method. ChildRowLockerCensusTest scans the source and fails on a site missing here or gone, and
# on an after-registry verdict the scan cannot prove. A no-registry-lock verdict says why no registry waiter can sit behind the lock.
